She showed up. He pretended he didn't care.

Dante spent the whole dinner giving side-eye while Flora just sat there looking adorable, wondering why he wasn't sharing his treats. This is basically every couple's dinner — one who planned the whole thing and one who's "just here for the food."

Which one are you on a date? Be honest. 👇
